Name: ClearHotpot
Author: xinzhuoxin
Description:
At Fishing Level 5, you automatically learn three recipes in the crafting menu.
Crystal Pot: Refined Quartz ×3
Sashimi: Made by slicing fish you catch with a fishing rod (does not include crab pot catches, quest fish, or seaweed/algae).
Quality is based on “base sell price × quality multiplier” (excluding the Fisher profession): 50 or lower Normal, 51–100 Silver, 101–200 Gold, over 200 Iridium.
Hold Sashimi and click the pot to cook for 8 seconds.
After the completion sparkle appears on the pot, click it again to collect Cooked Fish of the same quality.
Pierre sells Soy Sauce for 150g.
Clear Water Hot Pot: Cooked Fish + Soy Sauce. Quality is inherited. Silver/Gold/Iridium grant +1/+1/+2 Luck and last 3/5/8 minutes, respectively.
